milestone.description: Error bars for chain_fit to D 215: the fit spread past 165 (T152), a release-step correction that passes the fit-pair test or a reason none exists, the D = infinity anchor, and the low-D legs.

issue.body:
**What.** Continue T140's degree-6 and degree-10 held-fit chains from D 165 with the octo-double series, toward 215. The coordinator writes the entry once T151's checks pass.

**Why.** Digest, "In flight" (next for the laptop) and the digits line: above D 165 the only error estimate is the release step, and T152 extends the "fits" error bar there ([notes/BIAS.md](https://github.com/nmoinvaz/choptuik-large-d/blob/main/notes/BIAS.md); [notes/QUAD_DOUBLE.md](https://github.com/nmoinvaz/choptuik-large-d/blob/main/notes/QUAD_DOUBLE.md) 13.25).

**Acceptance (each can fail).**
- A pilot of a few steps first, with the stop rules of the chain (three halvings, the hang rule).
- At D where both chains and T138's degree-8 chain exist, their spread grows smoothly. A jump at 165 more than ten times the spread at 160-165 stops the run and is reported.
- Hourly posts with D, steps, |F|, Delta, cpu and memory, and a push of `T152-win/` at each.
- Raw output goes to a task folder of the raw-data repository (AGENTS.md), and `python3 raw_check.py <folder> PATTERN` passes on it.

**Depends on.** Finish T151's checks of the octo-double build on the win laptop

**Files.** [hp/anm_run.py](https://github.com/nmoinvaz/choptuik-large-d/blob/main/hp/anm_run.py), [hp/held_fit.py](https://github.com/nmoinvaz/choptuik-large-d/blob/main/hp/held_fit.py), [notes/BIAS.md](https://github.com/nmoinvaz/choptuik-large-d/blob/main/notes/BIAS.md), [notes/QUAD_DOUBLE.md](https://github.com/nmoinvaz/choptuik-large-d/blob/main/notes/QUAD_DOUBLE.md)
